value.title: Phase 1: Output-mode contract + seams
value.summary: Freeze the output-mode rule, renderer seam, and watch wire contract.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: PM-solo. When this closes, three coders build in parallel against frozen seams.

value.title: Output-mode decision function in core: resolve(tty, --json, --human, FS3_OUTPUT env) -> Json|Human, precedence flags > env > tty-detect; table-driven tests for all combinations. Jordan ruling verbatim recorded in rustdoc: default human, --json available; piped stays JSON so agents never break.
value.success: One function, one precedence table, exhaustively tested.
value.receipt: fs3_core::output::resolve + exhaustive precedence table; cargo test -p fs3-core --lib output = 3 passed. Commit 6915876.

value.title: Renderer seam: the trait/entry the CLI calls with (envelope, verb) after producing the frozen envelope — rendering NEVER mutates or reorders envelope production, so --json output is the same bytes as today by construction. Uncovered verbs fall through to JSON honestly.
value.success: Seam compiles with a stub renderer; envelope path provably untouched (existing envelope tests unmodified).
value.receipt: crates/cli/src/render.rs seam + emit renders FROM the serialised bytes; four flag/tty cases produce identical bytes (md5 verified) and goldens green. Commit 6915876.

value.title: Piped-byte-stability goldens: capture current main's JSON output for the covered verbs against a fixture store as committed goldens; the ac-0002 byte-identity test asserts against them.
value.success: Goldens committed with provenance; test red if any envelope byte drifts.
value.receipt: crates/cli/tests/envelope_goldens.rs + 15 goldens captured with the 1ce572b binary; provenance and shas in goldens/PROVENANCE.md. Commit 15f6982.

value.title: --watch wire contract frozen: NDJSON record shapes (event kind, timestamps, queue transition, root change), versioned envelope line first; documented in docs/services/ as the contract both u-w implements and u-t consumes; reviewed against DL-045 and the TUI POC's mocked-feed needs.
value.success: Contract doc + serde types committed; u-w/u-t coders build against types, not prose.
value.receipt: fs3_core::events (hello + 6 kinds + Unknown forward-compat) with 5 round-trip tests; docs/services/event-stream.md. Commit 1715175.

value.title: Adopt pocs/human-render fixtures + LEARNINGS promotion shape into the plan assets (vendored pointers, sha-pinned where copied); record what the POC proved so u-r cites rather than re-derives.
value.success: Assets in place; u-r packet points at them.
value.receipt: assets/inputs/README.md pins 6 inputs by sha256; tui-poc VERDICT vendored. Commit 1715175.

value.title: Payload DTOs moved core-ward into fs3_core::views (search, status, roots, remove, read, doctor) so a consumer can read a typed payload without depending on the daemon or the CLI. Byte-neutral: serde attributes and field order verbatim, Deserialize added to producer-only types.
value.success: Workspace builds, gate green, and the tk-a103 goldens - captured BEFORE the move - stay byte-identical.
value.receipt: Commit 4559b3f; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; envelope_goldens green after the move. Added by PM ruling B (prime, 2026-08-28) after the PM found the types straddled the u-r/u-w fence.
